svg.title: Published research
svg.desc: Two sole-author journal papers. MentalChat16K: BERT 86.7% accuracy, 86.1% F1 on 16,084 conversations, significance-tested. Yelp topic evolution: 97.2% entity recognition F1, 87.5% topic diversity, 17.9% forecast error, significant regional differences.
